persons.name: Citta
persons.evidence: dānapate suvarṇṇapanārimahānagare maitrīpūrimahāvihāre śrī 3 vajradevyā śevitaśrīvajrācāryacitta[[m]] ne(!) leṣāpitavyam(!)

notes: The commissioner's name appears as 'citta[[m]] ne(!)', which may represent the personal name Citta (or Cittamani/Cittana) with the Newari ergative suffix -ne/-na. 'śrī 3 vajradevyā' refers to the deity Vajradevī served by the donor.
